name: 01840 · Lawrence, MA
findings: ZIP 01840 (Lawrence) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (11% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01840 (Lawrence) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01840 (Lawrence) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.
